nom: DERMA E Essentials Radiance Toner with Glycolic Acid

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combo-oily skin report the toner keeps oil at bay, balances T-zone shine, and does not feel greasy despite exfoliating.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including winter-dry skin, describe it as hydrating and non-drying if used only a few times a week, though a couple report new breakouts or no visible change.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers say it balances oily and dry areas together and reduces occasional hormonal breakouts without over-drying.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly tolerate it well when introduced gradually, praising it as gentle and non-irritating, but a minority report itching, redness, or the need to rinse it off immediately.
segments.mature: Reviewers over 50/60 report more even tone, brighter and firmer-looking skin, though one mature/dry-skin reviewer saw new breakouts and reduced frequency.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their 40s-60s report a more even, brighter, radiant complexion and improved texture over weeks of use; no dissent reported for this concern specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including dry-skin users, describe it as hydrating and non-stripping if used every other day; one reviewer notes it did nothing for dryness and left a crust residue.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers say it reduces redness and calms irritated or inflamed skin; however, two reviewers report their face turned bright red or itched immediately after use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the formula as gentle, alcohol-free, and non-stripping, easing into daily use without compromising the skin barrier.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading dark marks, more even tone, and diminished acne discoloration over a couple of weeks.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, shrunk pores, and resolved milia or bumps; one reviewer with mature/dry skin reports new breakouts, and another saw no change in acne.
concerns.oiliness: Oily and combo-oily reviewers report the toner controls excess oil and balances the T-zone without over-drying, with one describing it as ending an all-day greasy feeling.

aspects.libelle: Crusting or buildup around bottle opening
Bottle/cap design impractical, wish for pump or spray

extraits.texte: I have used Derma e products for about 20 years. This toner was the only toner I could find when I ran out of my firming DMAE toner. I knew I wouldn't be happy with it as I applied it since it has a predominant rose scent. Then, in a few minutes I started itching. I had to wash my face several times and then I threw the toner in the trash. This has me searching for a new skincare system. Very disappointing.

Got this recently and started using as directed on my "mature" (ok,old) dry skin. The only difference I noticed is that I started breaking out, which I never had much of a problem with - certainly not in years! I wonder if I should use it less frequently or just toss it.

As far as I know, I am not allergic to any of the ingredients but my face turns bright red when I use this toner. I haven't changed any other product and has happened immediately use. Maybe my skin is just too sensitive for it.

extraits.titre: I've gone through two bottles so far!
extraits.texte: Note: My first bottle of this toner was free in exchange for social media posts. Since then, I have bought it twice. I'm almost done with my second bottle, which is why I had to buy the Essentials Radiance Toner again. I have sensitive skin, but I worked my way up to using this daily. Initially I didn't apply it over the most sensitive parts of my face, and I immediately rinsed my face after using this toner. This was more of a precaution since I never had a reaction. Now I use it as part of my evening skincare routine. After cleansing my face (usually with the DERMA E CBD cleanser), I pat it dry, and then I apply this with a reusable cotton pad. I let my skin air dry for about a minute before continuing with my routine. I love how my skin feels and how it looks. Most acids are too strong for my skin, but I've never had an issue with this one.

I recently switched to this Derma E Essentials Radiance Toner and I am in love. I have combination skin and in my 20's, it seemed to lean more oily. Now that I'm in my 30's, it's definitely leaning more dry...but I still get the occasional hormonal breakout. My former toner was too harsh for my skin and was causing it to dry out even more, which also caused my skin texture to show more (I will admit it's great for clearing up acne). Now that I'm using this Derma E toner, my skin is clear, glowing, and so dang healthy looking! I feel so pretty in my own skin again. I'm not having to carry around travel-size moisturizers at all time anymore. Definitely worth trying out. Oh and one last thing...this toner reminds me of the Fresh Kombucha Essence. Smells and feels just like it.

I've been using this toner for about 4 months now and I don't see myself ever using a different type of toner. I have a health condition that can really dry out my skin, and when that happens it makes my skin so much more hydrated and I feel so much more comfortable. During the months where my skin tends to go more to the oily side, I feel like my skin is still very well balanced. The ingredients like glycolic acid, hyaluronic acid, and pycnogenol are amazing. Different parts of this contributes different benefits; Exfoliating, hydrating, anti-inflammatory, reduces redness, prevents UV ray damage and UVB wrinkles, and reduces melasma. It definitely smells like rose/botanical, but the smell becomes less and less noticeable with time regardless of how you feel about it (I'm personally totally fine with how it smells). I'd personally recommend this toner for people who are trying to prevent aging and are aiming to balance their skin hydration. Anyone who has more irritated or inflamed skin may also benefit from using this. If your skin is super sensitive, you may want to have another toner on standby, but this has so many soothing agents in it I think you'll be fine.

I used to be completely drenched in oil by end of day, eve when my skin was dry. Ever since I started using this my skin is perfectly normal!! It cleans skin in the morning without stripping. My skin isn't greasy and my makeup stays on all day now. Will keep on buying forever!
